headline: Light rain today, quiet Saturday, then possibly windy Sunday night into Monday.
summary: A weak storm and a stalled front to the south are bringing light rain north into western Washington today, with light snow in the passes. A weak area of high pressure gives a mostly quiet Saturday, but the break won't last. A more active pattern returns early next week, and a low pressure system could bring strong winds to the coast and lowlands Sunday night into Monday. Forecasters can't yet say how strong the winds will be, since the models disagree on the storm's track. Rain returns Sunday. Later in the week, the storm track should shift south toward California, bringing somewhat quieter weather here. Coastal flooding remains a concern this weekend, especially on the northern coast, and high tides could bring more flooding next week.
